key_idea: Count the petals and the leaves on each flower.
steps: We need a flower with 4 petals and 2 leaves.
Count the pink petals: A has 5, B has 3, C has 4, D has 4, E has 6.
Only C and D have 4 petals. Now count their green leaves.
C has 2 leaves. D has only 1 leaf. So C is the flower.

choice_feedback.A: This flower has 5 petals and 3 leaves.
choice_feedback.B: This flower has 2 leaves, but only 3 petals.
choice_feedback.D: This flower has 4 petals, but only 1 leaf.
choice_feedback.E: This flower has 2 leaves, but 6 petals.
